title: Run dashboard widgets
description: Run live queries for dashboard widget tiles and return results. Requires the dashboard-widgets feature flag. Call dashboard-get first to find widget tile IDs (tiles with a widget field). Pass tile_ids as a comma-separated list. Each successful result is a widget-type-specific payload (see run_widgets OpenAPI response and dashboard-widget-catalog-list config_schema). Returns per-tile errors when the caller lacks product access for a widget type (see required_product_access on dashboard-widget-catalog-list). Not available on public/shared dashboard views.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: Live widget query result payload. List widgets return results (array), limit (configured page size), hasMore (boolean), totalCount (matching rows for current filters), totalCountCapped (true when totalCount hit the widget max and more may exist), and optional offset/nextOffset. error_tracking_list results are issue summaries; session_replay_list results are recording metadata.
